'''Peter Campbell''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Gold 106 from Dunedin, New Zealand. The slot was marked Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.<ref name="sm-fan" />

He played from the game's release and was for a time the highest-ranked New Zealand player. His profile listed him in the Calamari region.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
